Maya: Quick sync 0000We need a compact GA acceptance checklist for the Dedicated pilot. Scope: SLA tiers, minimal public docs, oncall handoff, monitoring deliverables, and pricing (burst vs committed). Can we assign owners + deadlines today?
Alex: Suggest 3 tiers: standard / priority / enterprise. Keep mapping simple to start.
Jordan: Raw SLO proposals (inference p95/p99):
standard: p95 <= 300ms, p99 <= 800ms, uptime 99.6%
priority: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 500ms, uptime 99.9%
enterprise: p95 <= 100ms, p99 <= 300ms, uptime 99.97%
Also error-rate targets: std <1.2% prio <0.6% ent <0.15%. Will add synthetic cold/warm probes.
Priya: Triage rules: Platform auto-detects and attempts auto-remediation; human page windows differ by tier. I'll propose rotation names + escalation matrix by EOD.
Sam: GTM: enterprise customers expect named support + onboarding check-ins. We should define what "named" means. Also need pricing bands: list / committed term / overage.
Ravi (Finance): Estimate: priority adds ~15% cost; enterprise adds ~30%. Credits proposal: standard <=5%, priority <=12%, enterprise <=30% cap on monthly. Need Legal review.
Elena: Docs: public SLA summary, short onboarding expectations doc, pricing matrix. Internal: runbook with rollback/fallback behaviors, dashboard guide. I can draft public pages once SLOs and fallback text are settled.
Alex: Rollout policy idea: enforce priority by default for pilot; allow opt-up to enterprise with capacity commit; standard = opt-down for very small customers. We'll gate enforcement behind a feature flag for 10 days.
Jordan: Fallback behavior: if enterprise reserved capacity exhausted, automatically route to a fast-quantized variant with response header x-redwood-degraded=true and 10% higher latency SLO documented. Add clear API error code for degraded SLA.
Priya: Oncall tiers: standard -> Platform L2 -> Product oncall; priority -> Platform L1 -> Product L1 -> CS; enterprise -> Platform L1 + named CS + 24/7 escalation. I'll drop rota names by EOD.
LegalBot: Reminder: any SLA credits or remedies require Legal sign-off. Submit draft SLA + credit table to legal-review channel.
Maya: Owners & deadlines:
- Jordan: final SLO table + fallback spec + dashboard templates. Due: 48h.
- Elena: public SLA page + pricing matrix draft. Due: 72h.
- Priya: oncall rotation + triage matrix. Due: EOD today.
- Alex: rollout policy + feature-flag plan. Due: 72h.
- Ravi: pricing impact + credits model. Due: 72h.
- Sam: sales one-pager + FAQ bullets. Due: 72h.
- Maya: consolidate acceptance checklist and publish. Due: 96h.
Maya: Blockers?
Sam: Two pilots asked for enterprise; please don't commit until we have doc + price.
Ravi (Finance): Also run a 6-month margin simulation for enterprise with 10% and 20% committed discounts.
Alex: I'll implement the feature flag and a monitoring hook to measure enforcement drift.
Maya: I'll ping Legal + add folks to review loop. If you want to be added ping me. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
